name: ElasticVue Pro client resources
author: ElasticVue Pro
description: One row per client: requested, allocated and used — servers, CPU, memory, disk — per family (ES, Parser, Forwarder, Engine …) or per role, ES storage and log delay; each client expands into its servers. Columns renamed, hidden and reordered in the Columns dialog; a Type filter; CSV and Excel export with a Servers sheet.
